title: Synthetic response payload totals
method: Assume 100,000 responses of 1,200 JSON bytes or 700 protobuf bytes. Totals are 120,000,000 and 70,000,000 bytes, expressed as decimal MB. Excludes headers, TLS, compression, requests and retransmissions; not a benchmark.
alt: Synthetic response payload totals. JSON assumption: 120 MB; Protobuf assumption: 70 MB. Illustrative inputs.
